Scored all cells. Gave low scores to the accusative case on pauperes and regnum and flagged both: each is a subject, so nominative.
Scored all cells. Most are well attested in the trusted data and score high. ipsi has lower confidence because Pp vs Pd is ambiguous.
Scored all cells. Flagged qui feats: it is plural (subject of plural lugent), not singular. Gave ipsi Pp/Pd medium confidence.
I scored all the cells. Most are high; qui's Number=Sing is likely wrong (subject of plural verbs), so I flagged Number=Plur.
Scored all cells high: they match the trusted analyses. Word 4 (ipsi) gets 0.68 because Pp vs Pd is ambiguous.

Scored all cells and gave most of them high confidence. Flagged two feats as likely wrong: qui should be Plur, regnum should be Nom.
Scored all cells; most well attested. Flagged dixerint FEATS: in this cum-clause it should be perfect subjunctive, matching fuerint and train:30405.

I gave all 11 words heads and validation passes. Beati is the root; I set patiuntur and the quoniam-ipsorum clause, both less certain, under it.
I labelled all 11 relations, following the trusted Vulgate examples: the 'qui patiuntur' clause as nsubj, and 'ipsorum est regnum' as advcl with cop.
Kept 'ipsi' as PRON (standalone subject pronoun) and raised its confidence to 0.88; no other UPOS changes.
Kept XPOS 'Pp' for 'ipsi' (word 4) and raised confidence to 0.8; trusted data uses both Pp and Pd, but Pp is more frequent.
Kept FEATS for 'ipsi' unchanged (Pp, Person=3, PronType=Prs), the most common analysis in the trusted data. Raised its confidence to 0.85.
Set all heads: beati is the root, misericordes and consequentur attach to it, and quia, ipsi and misericordiam attach to consequentur. Validates with 0 errors.
Labelled the sentence: beati root, misericordes nsubj, quia mark, ipsi nsubj, misericordiam obj, consequentur advcl, matching the training data's 'beati oculi quia vident' pattern.
Changed 'pauperes' and 'regnum' from accusative to nominative as subjects; resolved both flags.
Set all eight heads: beati is root, pauperes→beati, spiritu→pauperes, ipsorum is the predicate of the clause attached to beati. Validates cleanly.
I labelled all eight relations: beati is root, with pauperes as nsubj and spiritu as obl. The quoniam clause headed by ipsorum is advcl, following trusted Matthew 19.14.
Set UPOS to VERB for sedisset (word 9) and aperiens (word 16); left other tags unchanged.
Set XPOS 'V-' for sedisset and aperiens (both verbs, matching trusted VERB convention); other cells unchanged.
Set lemma 'sedeo' for sedisset and 'aperio' for aperiens. Both lemmas appear often in the trusted data. No flags raised.
Filled sedisset (pluperfect subjunctive) and aperiens (nominative participle) FEATS; set suum to Neuter to agree with os; resolved flag 1.
Filled in all 21 heads: ascendit is the root, with accesserunt and docebat attached as coordinated clauses and the participles as dependents. Validation passed.
Labelled all 21 words: root ascendit, two conj clauses, advcl for the participles and the cum clause, and the usual case, obj and det.
Changed mundo to ADJ (clean, agreeing with corde) and resolved the flag. Kept ipsi as PRON with higher confidence.
Changed mundo XPOS to A- (adjective, 'pure'); kept ipsi as Pp, consistent with its features.
Changed mundo to Case=Abl|Degree=Pos|Gender=Neut|Number=Sing to agree with neuter cor; kept ipsi's features and raised confidence.
I set all heads: beati is the root, corde depends on beati, mundo on corde, and videbunt is a clause under beati with quoniam, ipsi and Deum.
Labelled all 7 relations: root, amod, obl (corde, uncertain), mark, nsubj, obj and advcl for the quoniam clause.
Set UPOS to VERB for maledixerint (0.97) and mentientes (0.9, participle). Other cells left unchanged.
Set XPOS to V- for maledixerint and mentientes (both VERB); other XPOS values left unchanged.

Set UPOS of 'pacifici' to ADJ (0.85), following trusted pacificus ADJ; other cells left unchanged.
Set XPOS of 'pacifici' (word 2, ADJ) to 'A-', the tag the trusted data uses for ADJ. Left the other XPOS cells unchanged.

Set FEATS for 'pacifici' to Case=Nom|Degree=Pos|Gender=Masc|Number=Plur, matching 'beati'. The other FEATS cells are unchanged.

Set mites to ADJ (substantivized adjective, 0.9); kept ipsi as PRON (0.85).
Set mites XPOS to A- (ADJ); kept ipsi as Pp, matching trusted pronominal nsubj uses of ipsi.

Labelled the deprels as root, nsubj, mark, nsubj, advcl and obj, following trusted beatitude parallels (beati oculi quia vident).

Set esuriunt, sitiunt and saturabuntur to VERB (0.97). Kept ipsi as PRON and raised its confidence to 0.93.
